title: design-package-import/v1 — importer-authored receipt (docs/design/manifests/<dir>.import.yaml)
description: HANDOFF-LEGO-PIPE-024-R1 contract. Written by the importing agent when a cut lands (or bounces): the record of what was received, its digests, and its disposition. Lives OUTSIDE the verbatim package tree so `diff -r` against the received bytes stays empty with no exclusions. A digest field holds a digest or null — never prose (025 R-23 / 026 R-01).

package_path.x-note: Repo-relative path of the verbatim tree, e.g. docs/design/H-01-R1. Null ONLY for disposition rejected / recorded_not_imported, where no bytes land and the record IS the trace (025 R-20 / outcome 12). See x-conditional-required: disposition 'imported' requires both package_path and tree_sha256 non-null, enforced by package_preflight.py.

tree_sha256.x-note: Reproducible digest of the received tree; the subject pins and supersedes resolve through. Specification (x-tree-digest-spec below) is normative. Null only for dispositions that landed no bytes.

archive_sha256.x-note: Digest of the received archive, when one existed and was hashed. Null when unavailable (e.g. the three historical desktop bundles arrived unzipped). Historic claimed values that cannot be re-verified go in archive_sha256_claimed on the overlay, not here.

disposition.x-note: A cut that fails preflight or arrives without a designer manifest is RECORDED, not imported (025 R-09 amended, R-20): this record plus an instruments row with the matching Status land, the previous pin does not move, and any degraded import is an explicit operator-authorized exception.

import_date.x-note: A date is a STRING: quote it in YAML (`"2026-09-25"`), or the parser yields a date object and this field fails.

authorized_by.x-note: the AUTHORITY — never the producing agent, never null

date.x-note: A date is a STRING: quote it in YAML (`"2026-09-25"`), or the parser yields a date object and this field fails.

waivers.x-note: A waiver NAMES AUTHORITY: who authorized import despite a declared defect, on what date, under which memo, with what disposition/expiry. Never authored by the producing agent alone. The four x-never-designer-waivable classes in design-package/v1 cannot be waived here either.

x-conditional-required.imported: disposition 'imported' requires non-null package_path AND tree_sha256; 'rejected' and 'recorded_not_imported' permit both null — no bytes landed, and the record is the trace. Enforced by package_preflight.py.

x-tree-digest-spec.definition: Regular files only — error on symlinks or other special files. Walk the tree, collect POSIX relative paths, sort bytewise. For each file compute sha256 of its bytes. The tree digest is the sha256 of the UTF-8 concatenation of one line per file: '<sha256-hex><space><space><path>\n' (sha256sum-manifest style). File modes and mtimes are ignored (git does not preserve them).
